# Facts must be identity-free

The Fact IR model must not include a 'slug' field, while the Entity IR model must include 'slug'.

Keep fact records free of identity fields to separate descriptive facts from entity identity, preserving the IR boundary invariant.

**Anchored to:**

- `tests/test_smoke.py` — `tests.test_smoke.test_fact_ir_is_identity_free`
